Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.

progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?

accept.text: You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.$B$BI have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.

complete.text:
Coleman speaks well of you, $N, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

accept.text: The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.$B$BOur success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.$B$BAssist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.

accept.text: There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other Undead are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.$B$BBut because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.$B$BTo discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.

objectives.text: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

complete.text:
Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, well done.  But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.

progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?

accept.text: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.$B$BI must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!$B$BTravel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.

complete.text:
Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.

objectives.text: Speak with Deathguard Linnea.

accept.text: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.$B$BAnd if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.

complete.text:
It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

But we will not give in.  He will not take us again!

objectives.text: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

accept.text: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand.  It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...

complete.text:
Oh...my poor Thurman!  I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong!  And I knew it!  I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!!  Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!

<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>

But regrets are for the weak.  As a Forsaken, I have new goals and love is not one of them.  I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.

But that life is over.  Forever.

objectives.text: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.

progress.text: Yes?

complete.text:
Thank you.  Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed.  They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!

progress.text: Did you find Devlin?

complete.text: You have performed your bidding well, young $c.  You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.

progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?

complete.text: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.

progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?

accept.text: While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.$b$bBring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.

objectives.text: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.

accept.text: The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.$b$bKill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.

objectives.text: Executor Zygand in Brill wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries.

accept.text: Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.$b$bVarimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.$b$bVenture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.

complete.text: I appreciate your efforts, $N.  May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .

progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?

accept.text: Find Shaw in Old Town. Let him know that the Lescovar threat has been dealt with and about your involvement in the Lord's plots against the city. I'm sure he'll be proud to have another hero among Stormwind's citizens.$B$BHe'll more than likely send you off to meet with the Prince or some other noble. Don't let it get to your head, $n. The nobles can think they rule the city all they want, but some things remain out of their hands.

complete.text:
He is dead, then? Your justice was swift, $N. I pray to the Light that I never become your quarry!

<He laughs and claps you on the shoulder.>

I mean no criticism, $N. How could I, being the master of all assassins? But in truth, you have done the people of Stormwind a great service, and for that, I thank you.

objectives.text: Speak to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

accept.text: Ah, I almost forgot. Alexston came while you were away, he wished to speak with you. No doubt he wishes to report the goings-on of the Defias Brotherhood to the nobles.$B$BA bit of advice, $n: if anyone should ask, I would provide all details but that it was your hand that slew Lescovar. Trust me. I am... acquainted... with the ways of such things.$B$BAnd as far as Trias goes, well, speak to no one of him... ever... if you can help it.

complete.text:
It's good to see you, $N. I have heard that Lord Gregor Lescovar was found dead not long ago.

It would seem that you were successful in your mission. You have my gratitude that you have saved me, and many others, from VanCleef's revenge.

objectives.text: Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

accept.text: I have prepared a report for the King. I believe you should be the one to deliver it to him, along with an account of your findings. Do not worry, there is no doubt that he will commend you for doing your duty to the people of Stormwind.$B$BYour audience is scheduled soon, so you'd best hurry, it's a bit of a ways to Stormwind Keep.

complete.text:
You are to be commended for the service you have done for Stormwind, $N. If VanCleef had been successful in his machinations, he would no doubt have done considerable harm to the kingdom--something we must obviously avoid.

Take this, $c, as a token of the King's appreciation. I am only sorry he cannot present it to you himself, but he is away on a diplomatic mission and shall not return for some time.

objectives.text: Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

progress.text: $N, yes? I was informed by Baros Alexston that you would be coming. I must say, I am most interested in what you have to say.

complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.

progress.text: Yes?

accept.text: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $n, will be that agent.$B$BPresent these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.$B$BSo ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.$B$BYou may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

complete.text:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren.  Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.

objectives.text: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...

accept.text: Harmless pumpkins, right?  Or so it would seem.  If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.$b$bWith a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady.  This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.$b$bYet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.  Take this pumpkin to the fool.

complete.text: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .

objectives.text: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.

progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .

accept.text: The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.$B$BThis cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.$B$BAnd, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.$B$BKill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

complete.text: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.

progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!

complete.text: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.

accept.text: After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.$B$BWhile you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.$B$BLescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.

complete.text:
So it is done? Good. Thank you greatly for your discretion, $N. You've proven worthy on more than one count. I'll be sure to keep my eyes on you and your progress within the Alliance.

Be sure to keep your nose clean.

objectives.text: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.

accept.text: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.$b$bAs a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.$b$bTake these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.

objectives.text: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

accept.text: I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.$b$bMet Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.$b$bI'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.$b$bBeing that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.

objectives.text: Obtain $1oa Young Crocolisk Skins for James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

complete.text:
Ah yes, I remember Milton.  A bookworm, no doubt.  Bless him.

And he's right.  The Ruins of Alterac still hold stores of knowledge in danger of being lost!

Ogres now dwell in Alterac, and they don't care much for higher learning.

accept.text: Those beastly ogres now reside within Alterac's ruins, and I shudder to think what they're doing with the precious books still there.  You must recover what you can!$B$BEnter the Ruins of Alterac and search for tomes looted by the ogres.  Get whatever you can find and bring them to me, but also seek out one book in particular: The Arm of Gri'lek.  It contains ancient troll lore that I must learn, and the Ruins of Alterac was the last known location of an intact copy of this book.

objectives.text: Bring 5 Recovered Tomes and the Worn Leather Book containing The Arm of Gri'lek to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

accept.text:
We was splicin' the mainbrace somethin' fierce off of the Overlook Cliffs, ol' Hinterlands just in the distance.  Thought the seas was goin' to swallow us whole.

Ol' Slim knows all about liquid courage!  Cap'n had a crate of Pupellyverbos Port we commandeered from a privateer en route to Stormwind.

So when that storm off of Hinterlands hit, I busted into the grog.  Big wave hit and tossed them bottles overboard.  Cap'n is goin' to give me a taste o' the cat if ye don't help me get 'em back though!

objectives.text: Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay wants you to bring him the bottles of Pupellyverbos Port he lost.

complete.text: You place the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok within the cauldron...

progress.text: The greenish broth within the cauldron bubbles.

accept.text:
<The head of Nezzliok speaks.>

It is true.  I know where the child of the Darkspears was taken.  You have bested me and bound my spirit, but I will say nothing without appeasement!

The Bloodscalps war with the Skullsplitters.  To gain my favor, steal from the Skullsplitters 3 of their trophy skulls and place them here with us, so that my spirit will have slaves in the Nether.  One skull must be from their trophy pile in Balia'mah, another from Ziata'jai, and the last from Zul'Mamwe.

objectives.text: Bring a Balia'mah Trophy, a Ziata'jai Trophy and a Zul'Mamwe Trophy to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

accept.text:
<The head of Gan'zulah speaks.>

Curse you!  And curse your ancestors!!

Only blood and revenge can cool my rage, so if that is your wish, then... do this:

Throw yourself into the heart of the Skullsplitters to the east.  Slay the fiercest among them, and if you survive...then break yourself against their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel.  Hah!  Bring me his shattered armor if you can!

May he tear off your limbs and leave you to rot and be eaten by carrion.

objectives.text:
Kill 8 Skullsplitter Hunters, 6 Skullsplitter Headhunters, and 4 Skullsplitter Berserkers.

Bring the Broken Armor of Ana'thek to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

accept.text: You sure seem eager to work, matey.  Not sure why some land-loving $r $c is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.$b$bOur ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.$b$bAll the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies!  What I need is a scout.$b$bCheck the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.

objectives.text: First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Zanzil the Outcast dwells with his followers in the Jubuwai and Aboraz Ruins, northeast of Booty Bay.  He is exiled from his tribe.  Why? Well...

Zanzil has methods of bending the minds of others, and his leaders fear him.  He uses a mixture of jungle plants on his followers to suppress their will and strengthen their bodies.

His mixture would be worth much to those who wish to control others.

Bring me samples of his mixture, and I will find a use for them.

objectives.text: Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.

complete.text:
These will do nicely, $N. Great job.

I have the rest of the gear I'll need in my pack... thank the Light I just got a tailor friend of mine to make me a silk bag. I was running out of room carrying all my gear around.

Before Spybot heads in, let's get the details set so you know what you have to do.

progress.text:
I've been watching Lescovar for a couple weeks now. Trias has never trusted him, but we didn't suspect he was involved in anything to do with the Defias Brotherhood. We were following leads that tied him to the Twilight's Hammer. Either way, he's become more dangerous than this city can deal with, and that's where we come in.

Get me those items and we can put my plan into effect.

accept.text: My cousin Tran'rek is in a tight spot.  He promised me a load of scarab shells weeks ago and he hasn't delivered.  He's my cousin, so I'd hate to have to send someone to Gadgetzan to break something on him.$B$BCan you speak to Tran'rek for me?  Let him know he needs to get that delivery together before I do something rash?$B$BGadgetzan is in northern Tanaris, in Kalimdor.

objectives.text: Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

accept.text: The Quel'Danil Lodge is a center of communication for the high elves of the Hinterlands. Their ambassadors are working to establish relationships with other races, with whom they share their knowledge of the Witherbark trolls that inhabit the area in the southern Hinterlands. All of the documents regarding the communications are kept at the lodge.$B$BWe don't need the Highvale building alliances with others, $n.$B$BDestroy the Highvale documents.  We need to burn their lines of communication... literally.

objectives.text: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

complete.text: The loyalty of a Lich is unswerving, $N. Let them know that such loyalty will only bring them destruction.

progress.text: This matter is of utmost importance, $N. We must stop any attempt by the Scourge to bolster their ranks.

accept.text: Outstanding!  My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me.  I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin.  Yes - I said Scourge all right; they've brokered some sort of deal with the Quilboar here, and this nightmare is a result.$B$BListen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes.  Would you be up to helping me out to that end?  It's probably dangerous, but you seem to be the type not to worry about that too much.

complete.text:
Fantastic, I thought you looked to be the heroic type!  We've got our work cut out for us $N, I'm not going to lie to you.  If we stay focused on the task at hand, we should be able to come out on top.

Now, let me bring you up to speed on what's been going on...

objectives.text: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

progress.text:
I'm not one for politics; I care not if your affiliations are for either Horde or Alliance.  I am more interested in squelching direct and dire threats to all the races... and we have quite a large one in here.

If you're willing to be a true hero for all people, then hand me the oathstone I have given you as a sign of commitment.  I'm... not from around these parts; an oathstone is important to people of my kind as a bond of agreement.

accept.text: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; the beasts... they literally consume their abductees from the Barrens.  I can shut down the idol and bind them from using it again, but I need your aid in doing so.  My plan: escort me to the idol.  Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual.  I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself.  Protect me while I shut down the idol.  If they take me down, then it's all over for us.$B$BAre you with me?!

complete.text:
Belnistrasz's sudden departure has left behind a burning brazier.  As you stare in to the flame, the image of a great-winged red dragon fills your mind.  A more graveled version of Belnistrasz's voice speaks directly to you.

"Indeed mortals, you are the heroes I had hoped you would be.  Thanks to you the butchery these beasts were perpetrating is a thing of the past.  My faith in mortals such as yourself has been once more renewed.  Take this as a reward befitting of a hero."

objectives.text: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.$B$BProtect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.

progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?

complete.text:
Good. Well done, $c.

Now that Malcin is dead, we can at least know that the Scourges advances will be halted. The Dark Lady thanks you for your efforts and wishes to reward you with a gift.

Although we do not know the extent of the Scourges influence within the Downs, I am sure we will discover their plots soon enough.

progress.text:
Have you found the Ambassador, $N? Is he dead?

We cannot afford to allow the Scourge to take a foothold on Kalimdor. They are enough of a threat to our own borders to have to deal with them on two fronts.

The only optimistic sign from the events you've told me about is that the crone seemed uncorrupted. She must know deep in her spirit that the Scourge may bring great power, but that the Barrens would not truly be hers if she were to agree to their deal.

accept.text: Good day, doctor. You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Horde Trauma.$B$BNow pay attention! The critically injured must be tended to first. After the criticals come the badly injured. The injured should be tended to last. You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.$B$BTriage bandages will be supplied.$B$BGood luck, doctor.

complete.text: Doctor $N, welcome to Horde Trauma.

objectives.text: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.$B$BRemember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.

complete.text: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Bandarion Keep, brother.

objectives.text: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.

accept.text:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

complete.text: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.

progress.text: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.

accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.

complete.text: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

complete.text:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.

objectives.text: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.

complete.text: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?

objectives.text: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.

accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

complete.text: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

complete.text:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.

complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.

objectives.text: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.

objectives.text:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.

complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.

objectives.text: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: I suspect that seeing a few of their fellows bleeding on the ground will do wonders to dissuade any zealous ambitions these thugs might have had.

accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

complete.text:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, $N.

objectives.text: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.

accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

complete.text: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.

objectives.text: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.

accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

complete.text:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.

objectives.text: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!

accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.

complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

objectives.text: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?

accept.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

complete.text:
I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.

objectives.text: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.

accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.

objectives.text: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.

accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

complete.text:
Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.

You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.

I look forward to further making your acquaintance.

objectives.text: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

accept.text:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

complete.text:
So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.

Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?

objectives.text: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.

accept.text:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

complete.text:
Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?

There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.

objectives.text: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!

objectives.text: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

complete.text: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.

objectives.text: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

progress.text: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.

accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

complete.text: Thanks $c. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text:
These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village. 

With the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.

accept.text:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

complete.text:
<Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>

Storms curse--where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!

objectives.text: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.

accept.text:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.

objectives.text: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

objectives.text: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.

accept.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, it's clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>

objectives.text: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?

objectives.text: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.

progress.text: What news from the western watch?

accept.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

complete.text:
I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.

objectives.text: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

progress.text: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.

accept.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

objectives.text: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated $1oa Enchanted Skyhoppers.

accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

complete.text:
It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. 

If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.

objectives.text: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: What beautiful things did you bring me?

accept.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

complete.text:
Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.

objectives.text: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
A moment if you will, $n. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

objectives.text: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

accept.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

objectives.text: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.

accept.text:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.

objectives.text: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

complete.text:
<Kin'weelay's hands shake as you hand him the rubbings.>

These- these are in ancient Zandali! I can't believe they are still legible. No doubt you have been able to read these tablets as well.

These four tablets speak of the ancient city, though I have never heard this account before.

Nor have I ever heard of the Loa of Tides, have you? I thought all of the serpents depicted at the edges of the tablets were of Hethiss, but to my knowledge his avatar does not have a cobra hood or fins.

Could this then be a depiction of the Loa of Tides? It almost looks more like a sea serpent.

progress.text: $N! You have returned unharmed, and mostly in one piece it seems. Come sit, and tell me; have you ventured to the ruins of the Drowned City?

complete.text:
Excellent! I'll let the Baron know right away.

As promised, here's your share of the reward.

progress.text: Heya! Have you had a chance to take care of those blasted pirates yet? I have a crew standing by to go plunder-- er, explore the $r ruins.

complete.text:
I can't thank you enough! I will be able to sleep better knowing there are fewer of those Saltseers around.

I know the Baron also appreciates your service. Here's your bounty.

accept.text:
$N, you know our tribe keeps our traditions alive by oral storytelling and passing legends such as these to the next generation. No doubt you yourself have learned lessons and heard such cautionary tales in your youth.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. I am sure he would be happy to see you again, and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.

objectives.text: Take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.

complete.text: Well met!

objectives.text: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

objectives.text: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.

complete.text:
Good goin', $c. This be exactly what I'm needin'.

Let's just keep this little transaction between us, ya? What Muln and the others don't know, won't be hurtin' nobody!

progress.text: How you doin' mon? Job done yet?

accept.text:
Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.

objectives.text: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

complete.text: Stay low and try not to be seen, $c. These cultists are not to be trifled with.

objectives.text: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.

accept.text: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.

complete.text: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.

progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

accept.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

objectives.text: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

complete.text: This will do nicely. We've deprived our enemies of an important tool, and equipped ourselves with a powerful weapon to use against the Scourge.

progress.text: The Death's Head quilboar have been a constant thorn in our side for years, due in no small part to machinations of that accursed Lich.

accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $n. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.

complete.text: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.

objectives.text: Bring Shelene Rhobart $1oa Duskbat Wing Membranes, $2oa Darkhound Hides and $3oa Vile Fin Murloc Skin.

progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.
